_comment: Where everything lives. folders = the folders; kinds = what goes where (CLAUDE.md shows it, placement-law enforces it); concepts = which rules fire where. Edit here, then run `npx --no-install @thedecipherist/claude-packs update`.

app.purpose: the standalone, processor, editor, player, demo and the one launch function (launch.cpp)

app_gates.purpose: the gate readers: the window's STELLIX_LOOK_* readings (state and steps), linked only by the gate build StellixGates (stellix_gate_readers), never by the shipped Stellix.app (F9)

app_copy.purpose: a COPY TREE (kind copy): Tabula 1's PIANO loader, bridge and prebuild tool (they use JUCE, which the engines may not see), copied unchanged by tools/copy_tabula.py; read-only as every copy tree

snapshot.purpose: the one shared snapshot header the painter reads (header-only)

world.purpose: the world: travellers, strikes, rebounds, PULL, walls, the snapshot ring, State and the seeded RandomSource

engines.purpose: SlotSound and Tabula 1's voice, copied and proved (src/tabula is changed only under null tests, L8 and d-14, each changed part pinned by tools/copy_tabula.py --check)

engines_copy.purpose: a COPY TREE (kind copy): Tabula 1's voice, effects and dspblocks files and PIANO's recordings, copied unchanged by tools/copy_tabula.py; read-only (L8): every file has its origin line (repo, commit, SHA-256, licence row), changed only under null tests and pinned

engines_own.purpose: PROMOTED files (kind own): copied files that measured identical to their source, moved out of the copy tree by tools/copy_promote.py into Stellix's own code, each with its .origin record (origin line, licence row, the measurement); these may be changed

dsp.purpose: effects and dynamics: delay, EQ, compressor, limiter (S11a-S11d)

painter.purpose: everything drawn: scene, camera, card, GPU layer, shaders, the Painter facade

gpu.purpose: the Dawn (WebGPU) foundation: the shared instance and device, the render thread, the CAMetalLayer surface, the HDR target and tonemap, the off-screen path, embedded WGSL (F6); lib/gpu/harness holds the test harness's GPU readbacks (pictures, opt-in timestamps), never run in a normal frame

records.purpose: data/records (fixed ids, moons) and data/bank (factory patches)

probes.purpose: probe executables, each with --selftest, and the shot program (pictures, benches)

docs.purpose: spec, delay spec, laws, licences, research, work order (plan and logs at the root: build.md, bugs.md, workflow-bugs.md)

tools.purpose: build.sh, step.py, gates/, hooks/, plants.sh and plants.d/, copy and compare tools

git.branchStart: python3 tools/step.py start <STEP> "task" (work that is not a step: start --work <name> "task")

time.saveCommand: add new files by path, then python3 tools/step.py save "<note>"
